hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook
hook.description: A gamified Uniswap v4 hook on an ETH/KOTH pool implementing a king-of-the-hill mechanic: the largest buyer becomes "king" and earns 2% ETH fees on subsequent buys, while sells incur a 1% KOTH burn on the input side and a 2% ETH fee on the output side (credited to the king or treasury). Kings are dethroned by larger buyers or by dumping; stale unclaimed winnings can be forfeited by keepers after ~12 hours, triggering a buyback-and-burn of KOTH.
